name: player_transition_to_master_type_fly
description: Player::TransitionToMasterTypeFly selects the fly modal state when the transition cooldown allows it.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this Player transition helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player master-type transition cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b4c0 validates the fastcall save-state ABI, cooldown comparison between g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec and playerState+0x64, early return 0 while the cooldown is active, current modal masterType read at PlayerMasterModalData+0xa4, damageVisualFlag write at playerState+0x5c0 when leaving SUB, currentMasterType write at playerState+0x8, SelectModalStateByMasterType(saveState, FLY), cooldown write to g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec + 5.0f, and return 1.

The native smoke verifies the allowed transition from SUB records damage visual state, writes currentMasterType from the source modal, selects the fly modal, opens a five-second cooldown, and that the cooldown-blocked path returns 0 without changing modal selection or transition fields.
